target_customer: Small and mid-size beauty, wellness, health and fitness businesses in Latin America (salons, spas, clinics, gyms)
problem: Appointment based businesses took bookings by phone and paper and could not take online payments. AgendaPro offers online booking, reminders, payments, inventory and marketing in one system.
business_model: B2B SaaS subscription plus payment processing and marketing add-ons
product_category: Vertical SaaS scheduling and business management

founders.name: Julio Guzman
founders.background_notes: YC page: an engineer who still writes SQL and ships code.

founders.name: Sebastian Hevia
founders.background_notes: YC page: leads DevOps and architecture with Ruby on Rails, React and AWS.

founders.name: Nicolas Rossi
founders.background_notes: YC page says he built a BlackBerry app for the gas industry after college.

founders.name: Matias Ulloa
founders.background_notes: Only title on YC page. Ex-Ante says Guzman and Ulloa knew each other from playing football.

competitors.name: Mindbody
competitors.what: US wellness and beauty booking and business software described as a nearly identical product
competitors.traction_then: Large US incumbent in wellness scheduling
competitors.funding_then: Last valued at 1.9 billion dollars per Bloomberg Linea

competitors.name: Booksy
competitors.what: Beauty and wellness booking marketplace and business software
competitors.traction_then: Acquired Genbook on 2021-09-07 per a comparison page

technical_complexity.rationale: Scheduling, payments and clinical records across several countries and regulatory settings; standard SaaS engineering with local integrations.

defensibility.rationale: Customer calendars, records and payments create switching costs, but global rivals like Fresha, Booksy and Mindbody compete on similar features.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No global player acquired AgendaPro; it kept raising local rounds and expanded to 17 countries.

market_need_then: Bloomberg Linea reported 1.8M dollars ARR with 89 percent gross margins in March 2021; the YC page claims over 20,000 merchants today, and the founders said it was easier to buy a flight online than book a haircut.

identity.voice_and_tone: practical, Take Control, Automate and Grow Your Business

branding.brand_signature: Shopify for Beauty and Wellness in Latam positioning

brand_strength.rationale: Spanish word agenda plus Pro is clear in Latin America and the company has strong regional awareness and a large blog; no brand specific press found.

pivots.from: Marketplace to connect clients with salons and services (originally aiming to be a Groupon for services)
pivots.to: SaaS for scheduling and business management
pivots.why: Bloomberg Linea says the company first set out to disrupt Groupon in services; Ex-Ante says it began by connecting clients with salons. Exact pivot date not stated.

outcome_analysis: AgendaPro grew from a Chilean service marketplace into a regional SaaS leader serving over 20,000 businesses in 17 countries, with 1.8 million dollars ARR in March 2021. It raised 3.7 million dollars in 2022 and a 35 million dollar growth round in August 2025, which shows capital efficient growth followed by a large later round.
notes: The 2022 round is confirmed by Bloomberg Linea and also reported by Forbes Chile, Contxto and El Referente headlines (search results; Forbes and Contxto pages not opened). Stage label not stated in sources so recorded as other. The 2025 round is called a growth investment by Latamlist; VCBacked calls it Series B, which the article does not support. Aggregator totals conflict (CB Insights 42.55M over 11 rounds, FundedIQ 38.7M, VCBacked 35M), so earlier rounds may be missing; coverage is partial. Founded 2014 per YC; Bloomberg Linea says founded 2013 and launched 2014. Mindbody source is dated Jan 2022, about 10 months after the Winter 2021 batch. Booksy entry uses a current comparison page that mentions a Sept 2021 acquisition, weaker evidence. No shutdown or layoffs found.
